objective: Reliable contact and grip-force feedback on thin ENPIRE/YAM fingers
architecture_review: Eleven digital build packages exist: R1, L1, B1, B2.1, C1.1, N1.1, B3.1, FB1.1, K1.2, F1.1 R4 and P1.0. Optical integration remains in development. All twelve designs remain in the build-and-compare campaign; no physical winner has been established.
next_experiment: Build the eleven available packages while completing optical integration. Use common contact, force, precision, interference and repeatability tests through 20 N per finger; retain raw evidence and failed builds.

candidates.name: Independent resistive cells
candidates.coverage: two nail regions and four TPU regions
candidates.next: Fit, saturation, drift, edge coverage, and wear

candidates.name: B1 magnetic bending insert
candidates.status: separate CAD, PCB and raw readout designed; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: four compliant regions; optional R1 nail cells
candidates.next: Original-vs-B1 compliance, retention, interference, physical force calibration through 20 N

candidates.name: Dense flexible matrix
candidates.status: F1.1 R4 checked bench package with 96 CAD parts/references, twelve flexes, covers/molds, electronics and static-force workflow; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: 64 proposed locations on the two nail prongs and four TPU regions
candidates.next: Measure actual mating, adhesion, seals, slack, coupled-array behavior and physical contact/force through 20 N

candidates.name: Optical compliant finger
candidates.coverage: requires optical path and changed skeleton
candidates.next: Visibility under bending and preservation of nail access

candidates.name: Root normal-force cell
candidates.status: carrier, readout and fixtures designed; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: normal load through the complete finger mount
candidates.next: Housing fit, held-out moment loads, integrated-finger accuracy, stiffness and faults

candidates.name: Consolidated magnetic PCB
candidates.status: B2.1 checked PCB, support CAD and readout; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: same B1 magnet/head positions, with two N0 nail pads
candidates.next: Physical fit and power, calibrated contact/force tests, assembly and repair comparison

candidates.name: Differential-strain root force
candidates.status: C1.1 checked adapter, readout and numerical model; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: aggregate normal force through the original finger mount; bare nail retained
candidates.next: Drive fit, metal assembly, gauge bonding, real clamp motion, calibration and moving-arm tests

candidates.name: N1 bare sensing nail
candidates.status: checked steel nail, frame, readout and numerical screen; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: nail normal-force candidate plus four local TPU cells
candidates.next: Fit, bonding, whole-finger motion, calibrated mixed contacts, wear and precision tasks

candidates.name: Recessed magnetic frame
candidates.status: B3.1 revised frame, retained B2 board and field/clearance checks; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: magnetic soft region with separate nail pads
candidates.next: Actual frame stiffness, moving clearances, interference and paired B2/B3 contact/force tests

candidates.name: Shielded capacitive cells
candidates.status: K1.2 checked bench assembly, flex/readout, tooling and raw/static-force software; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: six contact cells and two protected reference capacitors
candidates.next: Measure posts, stop gaps and low-force signal; fit actual bracket/harness; calibrate independent specimens

candidates.name: P1 paired air-channel finger
candidates.status: P1.0 checked bench geometry/readout and raw/static-force tools; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: four front/back air-channel pairs and two thin N0 nail cells
candidates.next: Actual seals, sensor-port mating, hose motion, common-pressure cancellation, contact and 20 N reference-force tests

candidates.name: Packaged force button
candidates.status: FB1.1 guided root adapter, FMA PCB and static-force software; unbuilt
candidates.coverage: aggregate force through the original finger with a bare tip
candidates.next: Actual drive fit, measured preload/stops, real-joint motion and independent contact/force tests
